thesis: Every jurisdiction sees its own dashboard. One live source underneath.
mode_policy: all-light, by locked policy for this theme. There is NO site-wide 01-dark / 02-light / 03-dark rhythm: theme1's composition is mixed (filter-bar dark, band-b light, portraits light, map dark, table light) and theme3's own mode_policy says MIXED. Only 02 is single-mode.
render_target: sandbox /sandbox/show-the-work, Theme-2 section, via manifest -> BentoTheme adapter
